messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

long long int raise(long long int p, long long pow){
    long long int mod = 1000000007;
    long long int ans = 1;
    while(pow--){
        ans = (ans*p)%mod;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main(){
    long long int p, k, power = 1;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if(k==0){
        power = p-1;
    }
    else if(k==1){
        power = p;
    }
    else{
        long long int x = k;
        while(x!=1){
            x = (x*k)%p;
            power++;
        }
        power = (p-1)/power;
    }
    cout << raise(p, power) << endl;
    return 0;
}

</perturbed_code_1>
